items.statement: Staff will locate the main source of delay in the fixed booking slots rather than in individual decisions on the day.
items.rationale: A working proposition from the retrieved qualitative study (claim c1), to be tested against booking staff accounts.
items.risks: Staff may attribute delay to other staff groups.

items.statement: Women will describe uncertainty about when induction will start as more distressing than the length of the wait itself.
items.rationale: Suggested by accounts of conflicting information (claim c3).
items.risks: Recall of distress may change with the birth outcome.

items.statement: Evening surges will be described as the point at which workload becomes unsafe.
items.rationale: Unit data link surges to staffing ratios below one midwife to two women.
items.risks: Surges may be less frequent in this unit.

summary: Three working propositions to sensitise, not to test statistically.
